description: Source code for the MojoAndroidOverlay class, managing Android overlay surfaces in Chromium's media component.

classes.name: MojoAndroidOverlay
classes.description: Class managing Android overlay surfaces, handling surface readiness, layout, destruction, and power state.

methods.name: MojoAndroidOverlay
methods.description: Constructor initializing the overlay with provider, config, and routing token.

methods.name: ~MojoAndroidOverlay
methods.description: Destructor, signals overlay is done by dropping the overlay object.

methods.name: ScheduleLayout
methods.description: Schedules layout update for the overlay surface.

methods.name: OnSurfaceReady
methods.description: Handles surface readiness, acquiring and validating the surface.

methods.name: OnDestroyed
methods.description: Handles overlay destruction, signaling failure if no surface received.

methods.name: OnSynchronouslyDestroyed
methods.description: Handles synchronous destruction, calls OnDestroyed and runs callback.

methods.name: OnPowerEfficientState
methods.description: Updates power efficiency state and invokes callback.
